description: Connect classified hospital activity and versioned quotation sources without conflating tariffs, funding, resource cost and actual payment.
external_dependencies: edithatogo/mchs: classification-specific equations, activity editions and existing Rust/wrapper qualification.
edithatogo/reimbursement-atlas: authoritative quotation source registry, parsers, source licences and releases.
completion_evidence: The activity-only funding fixture produces the correct result with zero inferred or manufactured ResourceUse records.
Pricing/classification edition is retained separately from economic price year and quote knowledge date.
Unqualified synthetic/local fixtures are not presented as official rate releases.
Incompatible resource/activity quotations, stale applicability and missing source rights/status produce explicit diagnostics.
Resource cost, funding entitlement, tariff and observed payment remain separately queryable and are not summed by default.
